subject: L1·L2·L3 27 Oct: AI money is back: robots, vision, and trading tools just got funded.
lead: AI money is back: robots, vision, and trading tools just got funded.

tldr.text: AI money is back: robots, vision, and trading tools just got funded.
Anthropic says AI needs power, gas, and more grid patience.
Israel’s vote is stuck in coalition limbo; turnout was the headline.

hero.text: AI Money Shift is the day’s big drumbeat: capital is piling back into AI and deep-tech, from $600M robotics to tiny India bets on vision and wealthtech. The market wants the picks-and-shovels, not just the chatbot glitter.

scoreboard.line: Capital is rotating back into AI, from public markets to seed bets and giant robotics cheques.
AI growth keeps hitting electricity, siting, and power-chip limits.
AI firms are formalising control after trust and behaviour scares.
India’s election machinery is adding documents and trimming rolls harder.
High turnout, messy counts, and coalition math keep Israel stuck in limbo.

forces.line: Regulators are tightening voter rolls, AI governance, and the rules around power-hungry infrastructure.
Geopolitics is showing up in AI trust fears and Israel’s stalled government math.
Capital is flooding back into AI, robotics, and fintech tools with real traction.
Technology is hitting its own ceiling: power, data centres, and model control.

writer.pulse_india: India money went into health tech, physical AI, wealthtech, and trading: Cent, Nova Spectral AI, Vouch, Mochatrade.
writer.pulse_world: Outside India, funding showed up in robotics/autonomous construction and UK AI tooling: Bedrock Robotics, Querio.
writer.dots: The same regulatory mood is slowing both AI infrastructure builds and voter-roll administration: more local friction, more paperwork, higher execution costs.

call.prediction: If this is real, expect more AI companies to disclose power access or siting constraints within ~6 months.
